description: Is a request really from the crawler it claims to be (Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot...)? Give the address, the user agent, or both. The address is checked against the operator's published IP lists and, where the operator supports it, forward-confirmed reverse DNS under the operator's domain. Verdicts: verified, spoofed (claims a bot that publishes its addresses, but isn't from them), different (another known bot), unverified (the bot publishes nothing to check against), notbot, claim (user agent only: what it claims, never proof). The full report is at report_url (/verify-bot?ip=<ip>&ua=<user agent> on iplover.com).

ip.description: The request's IPv4 or IPv6 address.

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).

name: verify_bot

report_url.description: Public iplover page with the full report for this check: share it, or open it for the explanations and sources.

title: Verify a web crawler
